description: LEGACY (Python-only, structure only). Prefer gctrl_code_index for a real Codebase KB. Ingest a (Python) code repository into the knowledge graph: parses files into File/Class/Function/Module entities + CONTAINS/IMPORTS/CALLS/INHERITS edges (fully local, no LLM). Classification flows in like any other knowledge. Pass files as [{path, content}].

classificationLevelId.description: Optional classification level UUID for the ingested code

files.description: Repo files as {path, content} (Python .py files are parsed; others skipped)

name: gctrl_ingest_repo
